title: Scheduled agent loops fail silently on an unknown model or a missing login.
whatHappens: Codebase-health, latency and CI runs (07:50Z, 08:00Z, 08:35Z) answered "unknown provider for model gpt-6.1-sol". Errors loop, X ads pull and morning card (10:00Z, 13:30Z, 14:00Z) posted nothing. A sign-in card showed at 14:08Z. No 2 AM release run is recorded.
fix: one owner card at the first failed scheduled turn, and rerun missed runs after recovery (proposed).
